caption: Opening with smooth Hindi male vocals singing a romantic melodic hook over a modern electronic rhythm, the track abruptly transitions into an epic, suspenseful cinematic instrumental. Dramatic brass fanfares, surging orchestral strings, and rumbling timpani build intensity with rising dynamics and dramatic risers. The production shifts seamlessly from polished Bollywood romance to a grand, high-stakes film score atmosphere.
lyrics: उ मिट्ति विट्ती जाशनी मिट्ति मिट्ती उ मिट्ति मिट्ती जाशनी
